sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Alate: antenna 16-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 by less than half. Pronotum 1/3 wider than long, narrowed posteriorly. Measurements: body length with wings 19 mm; body length without wings 11 mm.

note: Adapted from Silvestri's 1901 "Nota preliminare sui Termitidi sud-americani" (in Latin), where the species was named Cornitermes longilabius sp. n. and only the number of antennal segments, the shape of the pronotum and the body length of the alate were recorded; type locality Coxipò (Cuyabá), Brazil. Descriptions of the soldier and worker appeared in the author's detailed 1903 report (not used to supplement this entry).
